tvShow.name: The Ramparts of Ice
tvShow.overview: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

episodes.name: Lines and Walls
episodes.overview: After her classmates run off in fear, Koyuki makes faces in a mirror to figure out why everyone finds her scary. Suddenly, a boy sneaks up behind her.

episodes.name: Locksmith
episodes.overview: To Koyuki's relief, Yota comes to her rescue. After their initial study session, they grow more comfortable with each other — which unsettles Minato.
Bothered that Koyuki still has her guard up around him, Minato tries to make small talk. As Miki grows suspicious of his intentions, she confronts him.

episodes.name: Impenetrable
episodes.overview: At Miki's prodding, Minato clarifies his interest in her best friend. An unexpected visitor triggers Koyuki's bad memories, leading to a harsh outburst.

episodes.name: Change
episodes.overview: Koyuki mulls over the tense exchange in the infirmary. After Yota clears the air, she tries to have an honest conversation with Minato for the first time.

episodes.name: New Semester
episodes.overview: As winter break ends, the usually calm Minato begins to realize his feelings are changing. Miki notices how close Yota and Koyuki have become.

episodes.name: Loneliness and Solitude
episodes.overview: After reflecting on her own loneliness and worrying that Yota is bottling everything up, Koyuki reaches out and asks about his true feelings.

episodes.name: On Equal Footing
episodes.overview: Determined not to mess up high school, Miki has faked her persona since day one. But not being herself around her classmates starts to wear her down.

episodes.name: Self-Awareness
episodes.overview: Minato realizes how Koyuki is always on his mind. Later, while hanging out at the new mall, the misunderstanding between the four friends deepens.

episodes.name: Spring
episodes.overview: A spring break trip to the amusement park brings the four friends closer. Back at school, Koyuki's surprised by a familiar face — and Minato takes notice.

episodes.name: Inversion
episodes.overview: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

episodes.name: Thunder
episodes.overview: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.

episodes.name: Perception
episodes.overview: With Akine's words ringing in her head, Koyuki's feelings become complicated. Later, an accident causes something to shift between Miki and Yota.

crew.name: Auttapon Boonsamai
crew.original_name: อรรถพล บุญสมัย

episodes.name: Bombshell
episodes.overview: Unsure of how to move forward, Miki avoids Yota and confides in her colleagues. A bold Momoka confronts Koyuki about Minato and lights a fuse.
